title: Prediction of preterm birth in nulliparous women using logistic regression and machine learning
summary: Artificial neural networks modestly predict preterm birth from Ontario nulliparous birth records, with independent validation and trimester-specific results.
ai_technology: Artificial neural networks predict preterm birth from maternal birth-record features.
organization: Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, McMaster University, Hamilton, Ontario, Canada.

evidence.tested: population cohort of 112,963; ANN validated on held-out sample, AUC 0.60 in first trimester and 0.65 in second, reaching 0.80 when pregnancy complications are included. Predictive value is limited early and relies on contemporaneous complications later.
